---
title: Fluent-inspired theme
description: 'Borrows the feel of Fluent 2 on the web: neutral greys, one brand blue, Segoe UI.'
since: '0.3'
---

import ThemePreview from '../../../components/themes/ThemePreview.astro';

```js
import '@argus-table/themes/fluent.css';
```

It borrows the feel of Fluent 2 on the web, not Microsoft's exact spec: neutral greys, one brand blue, Segoe UI, a flat header on the body colour and the sizes of Fluent's Table. Selected rows get a light brand tint, and the focus ring is black (white in dark mode), as in Fluent.

- **Fonts:** the theme loads no fonts. Segoe UI comes with Windows and isn't on npm; elsewhere the table uses the system font.
- **Rows:** 34, 44 and 52px for `compact`, `comfortable` (the default) and `spacious`, with 8, 12 and 16px of inline padding.
- **Light and dark:** `data-argus-theme="dark"` or `"light"` on the table or an ancestor forces a scheme; any token can be set after the theme. See [Themes](/argus-table/themes/).

The preview follows this site's light and dark switch. The status chips are the page's own CSS: cell content is light DOM.
